When you sign in to GitHub Desktop 3.6.10 or later, eligible accounts can now use short-lived, automatically refreshing authentication tokens. Short-lived access tokens reduce how long a leaked token can…

Short-lived access tokens reduce how long a leaked token can be used. Desktop automatically refreshes them for GitHub API requests and Git operations, k
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub Desktop 3.6.10 起，符合条件账户登录可使用短时自动刷新认证令牌，降低泄露令牌可用时长，并自动为 GitHub API 请求和 Git 操作续期；功能正逐步覆盖，暂不含 GitHub Enterprise Server。

en.reason: GitHub Desktop 3.6.10 and later now gives eligible accounts short-lived, automatically refreshing authentication tokens, reducing a leaked token's usable window and auto-renewing them for GitHub API requests and Git operations, though the rollout excludes GitHub Enterprise Server.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI为支撑Codex带来的并发开发规模，构建Git兼容后端Pando并用于其monorepo全部开发，生产中把中位push延迟降低近5倍，每天传输近1PB Git数据。

en.reason: OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend for Codex-scale development across its monorepo, cutting median push latency nearly 5x while transferring close to 1PB of Git data daily.

sources.title_en: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties
sources.title_original: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI将Security Bug Bounty中危、高危、严重漏洞奖励中点平均提高逾四倍，ChatGPT等核心产品严重漏洞最高3万美元，叠加质量、忠诚度与优先活动奖金后卓越发现可达17.2万美元。

en.reason: OpenAI has raised median Security Bug Bounty payouts for medium, high and critical vulnerabilities more than fourfold, with critical flaws in core products like ChatGPT now topping $30,000 and quality, loyalty and priority campaign bonuses pushing exceptional finds to $172,000.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI 将与 Cathedral 开展下一轮内部安全冲刺，用自家模型挑战防御，并将关键发现奖励提高至四倍以上；上次冲刺曾让25%产品工程师用 Codex 复现漏洞并准备补丁。

en.reason: OpenAI is planning its next internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems to stress-test defenses using its own models, with rewards for key findings raised more than fourfold after 25% of product engineers used Codex to reproduce vulnerabilities and prepare patches.

en.title: AI benchmarks shift toward real-world task execution as OpenAI launches LifeVal to measure personal assistant capabilities

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 开源本地大模型工具 Strata 0.2.10 通过动态调整显存与内存分配，让 8GB 显存设备也能启动 Qwen3.8IQ3_S 并维持 128K（131,072 tokens）上下文，官方测试在 DFlash2 模式下生成速度达 63 至 73 tokens/s。

en.title: Run 128K ultra-long context on just 8GB of VRAM! Open-source local LLM tool Strata 0.2.10 released
en.reason: Strata 0.2.10 dynamically adjusts VRAM and RAM allocation so 8GB-VRAM devices can run Qwen3.8IQ3_S at a 128K (131,072-token) context, with official DFlash2-mode tests generating 63–73 tokens/s.

stories.title: 人只够盯 5 个对话窗口，DeepSeek 让 AI 自己当"大管家"

sources.title: 人只够盯 5 个对话窗口，DeepSeek 让 AI 自己当"大管家"
sources.title_zh: 人只够盯 5 个对话窗口，DeepSeek 让 AI 自己当"大管家"
sources.title_original: 人只够盯 5 个对话窗口，DeepSeek 让 AI 自己当"大管家"
sources.recommend_reason_zh: DeepSeek 提出 Super-agent 愿景，指出人最多并行跟 3 到 5 个 Session，方案是隐藏会话并用 Router+Worker 两层架构让前端只面对一个 Agent，还把群聊、邮件、日历、GitHub 评论接入主动触发器。

en.title: People can only keep tabs on 5 chat windows at a time—DeepSeek lets the AI act as chief of staff
en.reason: DeepSeek’s Super-agent vision argues people can track only 3 to 5 Sessions at once, so its Router+Worker design hides sessions behind one Agent and connects group chat, email, calendar and GitHub comments as proactive triggers.

en.title: Tencent Hunyuan unveils an "AI scientist" that trains its own proteins, builds robotic hands—and turns around to improve the next generation of AI
en.reason: Tencent Hunyuan's research Agent Hyra 2.0 splits tasks across Overall, Mission and Worker layers, supports weeks-long continuous research, and requires code-and-log evidence plus independent Agent review, with protein, chip and robotic-hand validations.

en.title: ChatGPT to proactively end dangerous conversations, ban repeat offenders outright
en.reason: OpenAI will add stricter violence safeguards to ChatGPT in the coming weeks, letting the model end conversations that persistently focus on violence or serious harm and banning accounts repeatedly cut off.

sources.title_original: 六步实现音视频联合生成！Pika基于MiniMax H3 重磅开源Pika H3 Flex
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Pika 基于 MiniMax H3 推出 Pika H3Flex，开源 adapter 权重和完整推理代码，仅六步去噪即可联合生成音视频，并在 DesignArena 文生视频榜升至第八、成为榜上最高开源视频模型。

en.title: Six steps to joint audio-video generation! Pika open-sources Pika H3 Flex, built on MiniMax H3

stories.title: @TapeAIAgent 昨天和 TapeAI 创始人聊了很久，我终于对这个项目想解决的问题，有了一个更清楚的认识。 现在大家谈 AI Agent，往往会想到 Codex、Claude、豆包或者各种自动交易机器人。 它们都很聪明，也能够调用工具、读文件、写代码，甚至操作钱包。 但问题恰恰出在这里： 当一个 AI 的能力越来越强，我们靠什么约束它？ 我们怎么知道它获得了谁的授权？ 它可以动用多少资金？ 哪些地址绝对不能转？ 哪些合约不能…

en.title: Sharing an AI development workflow I've been really happy with lately — it mainly requires two apps, Magpie and Codex App. Magpie is absolutely fantastic: since switching over from cc, all my skills, MCP and providers are now connected to my Agents through Magpie.

sources.summary: 本周AI音乐周刊汇集了近期行业版权新规、商业变动与产品更新。韩国音著协探索AI音乐确权信托，Spotify计划推出合规AI翻唱工具，MiniMax收缩国内音乐云端业务。Suno MCP、ElevenLabs音效新模型、NI合成器等新品上线。还有6篇前沿论文，覆盖音频合成、乐谱建模等方向，适合音乐创作者、音频开发者快速掌握行业动态与落地工具。

en.title: AI Music Weekly W.A 052
en.summary: This week's AI Music Weekly rounds up recent copyright rules, business shifts and product updates. Korea's Music Copyright Association is exploring a rights-ownership trust for AI music, Spotify plans to launch a compliant AI cover tool, and MiniMax is scaling back its domestic music cloud business. New releases include Suno MCP, a new ElevenLabs sound-effects model and an NI synthesizer. There are also six cutting-edge papers covering audio synthesis, music-score modeling and more — a quick way for music creators and audio developers to catch up on industry trends and practical tools.
en.reason: KOMCA’s 27 October forum targets AI music copyright trust gaps with algorithm-involvement declarations, DAW stems and acoustic screening, alongside Spotify’s compliance AI-cover plans, MiniMax’s China cloud retreat and six frontier papers.

stories.title: DeepSeek这次，想把你从AI的监工岗位上解放出来

sources.title: DeepSeek这次，想把你从AI的监工岗位上解放出来
sources.title_zh: DeepSeek这次，想把你从AI的监工岗位上解放出来
sources.title_original: DeepSeek这次，想把你从AI的监工岗位上解放出来
sources.summary: 老金这篇文章把 Super-agent 的机制讲得很直白：Router 像调度员，记住任务关系并分派；Worker 在各自会话里并行执行，耗时操作转后台，独立检查者盯进度和跑偏。它用更多计算换更短、更稳的等待，但公开原型仍偏实验，需配 Harness、独立账号和隔离环境，主动任务先观察、代码先人工合并。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: DeepSeek产品部公布Super-agent设计探索，演示Agent从群聊接改字体需求、在同一个PR追加字号设置，经GitHub审查折叠设置项后回群通知合并。

en.title: This time, DeepSeek wants to free you from the job of supervising AI
en.summary: Lao Jin’s article lays out the Super-agent mechanism plainly: the Router acts as a dispatcher, remembering task relationships and assigning work; Workers execute in parallel in their own sessions, time-consuming operations get moved to the background, and independent checkers monitor progress and drift. It trades more compute for shorter, steadier waits, but the public prototype is still experimental and requires a Harness, separate accounts, and isolated environments. Proactive tasks should be observed first, and code should be merged manually first.
en.reason: DeepSeek’s Super-agent design exploration pairs a Router that dispatches tasks with parallel Workers and an independent checker, demoing an agent that adds a font-size setting to the same PR and reports the merge back to group chat.

en.title: I found an insane Skill! Drop in your subtitles and AI automatically generates a hand-drawn animated video (with step-by-step instructions)
en.summary: Making those "narrate while hand-drawing" explainer videos is a grind—you have to stitch together the drawing, timeline syncing, voiceover, and subtitles all by yourself. The author tested a Skill called srt-whiteboard-animation and found it worked pretty well.
en.reason: The srt-whiteboard-animation skill feeds SRT subtitles to AI agents like Codex or Doubao to auto-generate hand-drawn whiteboard animation videos, with a Survivorship Bias walkthrough showing the full workflow.

sources.title_zh: 人工智能时代中的“无我”数学
sources.title_en: Egoless Mathematics in the AI Era
sources.title_original: Egoless Mathematics in the AI Era
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Terence Tao博客的客座文章以“无穷多个素数在有人证明前已存在”为例，讨论AI时代数学应视为发现还是发明，以及数学家如何理解独立于个人的数学秩序。

en.reason: Infinitely many primes existed before anyone proved it, a fact Karthik C. S., Amit Sahai and Jie Xue use on Terence Tao’s blog to ask whether AI-era mathematics is discovery or invention and how mathematicians grasp impersonal order.

sources.title: AI时代无我数学的讨论
sources.title_zh: AI时代无我数学的讨论
sources.title_en: Egoless Mathematics in the AI Era
sources.title_original: Egoless Mathematics in the AI Era
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以“喜欢做、擅长做、有人付费”的三圈Venn图剖析AI冲击：数学证明三圈皆受威胁，数学家或转向解释结果与教学，software engineering则看目标是否“make something work”。

en.reason: A Venn diagram of what you like, are good at, and get paid for frames AI's threat to mathematicians seeking never-before-proven results, pushing them toward explaining results and teaching, while software engineering hinges on making something work.

sources.title: 10.26—11.1｜本周精选 AI 论文
sources.title_zh: 10.26—11.1｜本周精选 AI 论文
sources.title_original: 10.26—11.1｜本周精选 AI 论文
sources.summary: 这一周的精选 AI论文有个很明显的信号：AI 系统开始从“把更强模型塞进更多 Agent”，转向让检索、验证、记忆和模型协作各自做更确定的事。想把 Agent 做稳的人，这批研究比单纯看模型榜单更有参考价值。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 本期精选涵盖DecisionRAG与Unified Training：前者用决策模型逐层检索，在MultiDoc2Dial上R@1较密集检索加8B重排序器高13.8点，单次查询耗时0.7至1.8秒；后者把预训练到强化学习置于单一似然算法下。

en.title: 10.26–11.1 | This Week's Best AI Papers
en.summary: This week's curated AI papers send a clear signal: AI systems are moving away from "stuffing stronger models into more Agents" and toward making retrieval, verification, memory, and model collaboration each do more deterministic work. For anyone trying to build Agents that hold up, these studies are more useful than simply scanning model leaderboards.
en.reason: DecisionRAG's decision-model layered retrieval beats dense retrieval plus an 8B reranker by 13.8 R@1 points on MultiDoc2Dial at 0.7–1.8 seconds per query, while Unified Training unifies pretraining through RL under one likelihood algorithm in this week's selected AI papers.

en.title: ChatGPT's December quota merge: will we have to draft our prompts before asking?
en.summary: OpenAI's new December quota rules have rattled plenty of heavy users: advanced ChatGPT conversations and Codex will share a single Token pool, with only Instant quick chats exempt from the quota. The author's firsthand experience offers an early look at how subscription costs will shift, and decodes billing logic that mirrors Claude's — so you won't find your hands tied later when you want to use strong reasoning models.
en.reason: From December, OpenAI will make Plus, Pro and Business users share one Token pool across ChatGPT advanced conversations and Codex, with Instant chats exempt, and a hands-on account shows how subscription costs and strong-reasoning access change.

The author's firsthand experience offers an early look at how subscription costs will shift, and decodes billing logic that mirrors Claude's — so you won't find your hands tied later when you want to use strong reasoning models.
en.reason: From December, OpenAI will make Plus, Pro and Business users share one Token pool across ChatGPT advanced conversations and Codex, with Instant chats exempt, and a hands-on account shows how subscription costs and strong-reasoning access change.
